original_row.question_en: Trace sections from a resolution through its CR's affected clauses (decision-to-section trace).
original_row.cypher: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected <> '' MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber, cr.clausesAffected, sp.specNumber ORDER BY r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber LIMIT 10

original_Korean_row.question: Resolution이 참조한 CR의 clausesAffected를 통한 Section 추적은?

original_operational_domain.recorded_field_filter: cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected <> ''
original_operational_domain.field_authority: Original Korean explicitly names clausesAffected; original query and Phase3 source context implement recorded metadata to Section trace. A separate source-enriched field census is not silently inserted.

retained_counterauthority: English affected clauses can be read more broadly than stored field. Earlier real CR covers have direct clause values absent from frozen metadata; these are positive source-augmentation alternatives, not source-empty negatives.
Recorded REFERENCES is extracted from overextended content. Native relation presence alone does not certify source-faithful own decision ownership.
A first-header prefix rule can overexclude explicitly listed final CRs and retained same-subject contextual anchors; a new own parser needs source positives/negatives, not a desired answer count.

The unchanged first10 have positive literal clause cells, but three broad Resolution bodies contain later independent proposals/TDoc records. Correct answer fields alone do not close the source-relation gate.
forbidden_new_requirements: every original CR body or all1996 records without dependency proof
splitting literal clause strings into new answers
requiring arbitrary TP headings as exact Clauses affected fields
removing pCR or draftCR by type
treating a null field as source-empty
next_actual_gates: generic retained own REFERENCES source boundary; preserve contextual alternatives
fresh full typed SQL and exact guarded native if a question-preserving repair is proposed
independent exact7 review and ROOT seal
